Title: Successful User Registration with Valid Data
Steps: Send POST request to /api/v1/users/register with valid email, password, mobile, firstName, and lastName | Verify the response status code | Check response body for userId and authToken | Verify confirmation email is triggered
Expected: Response status is 201 Created. Response contains userId and authToken.

Title: Registration Failure with Duplicate Email
Steps: Register a user with email 'user@example.com' | Send a second POST request to /api/v1/users/register using the same email 'user@example.com' with different mobile number | Verify the response status code and error message
Expected: Response status is 409 Conflict. Error message is 'Email already registered'.

Title: Registration Failure with Invalid Password Policy
Steps: Send POST request to /api/v1/users/register with a password failing criteria (e.g., 'weakpass' lacking uppercase, number, and special char) | Verify the response status code and error details
Expected: Response status is 400 Bad Request. Details contain specific password validation error messages.

Title: Registration Failure with Invalid Mobile Format
Steps: Send POST request to /api/v1/users/register with mobile number not in international format (e.g., '12345')
Expected: Response status is 400 Bad Request with mobile validation error.

Title: Rate Limiting Enforcement on Registration Endpoint
Steps: Send 5 consecutive valid registration requests from the same IP address | Send a 6th registration request from the same IP address within the same hour
Expected: The first 5 requests succeed (or process normally), and the 6th request returns 429 Too Many Requests.
